87/// How [`Document::close_element`] and its variants treat open descendants that do not
88/// auto-close.
89#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
90enum CloseDescendants {
91  /// An Error (`malformed`).
92  Strict,
93  /// An Info line: the source groups were abandoned and reported already.
94  Abandoned,
95}

97pub struct Document {
98  pub document:                  XmlDoc,
99  pub pending:                   Vec<Node>,
100  context:                       Option<XPath>,
101  pub node:                      Node,
102  pub node_boxes:                HashMap<usize, Digested>, // used to be _box attribute
103  pub node_fonts:                HashMap<u64, Font>,       // used to be _font attribute
104  pub idstore:                   HashMap<String, Node>,
105  /// Streaming pass 1: every `xml:id` moved out of `idstore` by a spill.
106  /// The GLOBAL half of id-collision dedup — a later build-time minting of
107  /// the same id must rename exactly as eager would have (witness: the
108  /// 131 MB book restarts chapter numbering per part, and the second `Ch1`
109  /// collided only with a SPILLED chapter).
110  pub spilled_ids:               rustc_hash::FxHashSet<String>,
111  /// Streaming pass 1: the ids spilled runs mint their top nodes' ids under (`SegmentMeta::anchor`) while those
112  /// elements stay resident; once one spills too, its `_ID_counter_*` attributes move to `spilled_anchor_counters`.
113  spill_anchors:                 rustc_hash::FxHashSet<String>,
114  spilled_anchor_counters:       rustc_hash::FxHashMap<String, Vec<(String, String)>>,
115  /// Streaming pass 2: the segment's `SegmentMeta::anchor`. `generate_id` mints under it what eager mints under that
116  /// element, the parse wrapper holding its counters.
117  pub fragment_anchor_id:        Option<String>,
118  /// Every SVG `id` (the svg schema's ID attribute, not `xml:id`) handed out
119  /// (`record_svg_ids`). Ids only, no nodes or addresses: whether an element was already walked
120  /// travels on the element itself (its `_svgid` mark), so a removed picture leaves nothing
121  /// dangling, and an id stays taken once given.
122  pub svg_ids:                   rustc_hash::FxHashSet<String>,
123  /// The next suffix to try per SVG id base (`record_svg_ids`), so the n-th copy of a picture
124  /// does not re-probe the n-1 suffixes before it.
125  pub svg_id_suffixes:           rustc_hash::FxHashMap<String, i64>,
126  /// Streaming pass 1: every namespace PREFIX (`xlink`, `svg`, …) an element
127  /// or attribute of a spilled subtree used. `apply_document_namespace_
128  /// declarations` declares a prefix on the root only when it is used
129  /// (Perl behaviour) and scans the RESIDENT DOM; a prefix used solely inside
130  /// spilled segments (`xlink:href` on `svg:pattern`/`svg:use`) was serialized
131  /// unbound — six TikZ manuals flipped schema-invalid at the transition
132  /// watermark (atableau, circuitikzmanual, tikzlings-doc, tkz-grapheur-doc-en/
133  /// -fr, tzplot-doc; batch 56fr). Guard
134  /// `streaming_declares_namespaces_used_only_in_spilled_segments`.
135  pub spilled_ns_prefixes:       rustc_hash::FxHashSet<String>,
136  // the rewrite labels used to be in each rewrite rule, but they make more sense in doc
137  pub rewrite_labels:            HashMap<String, String>,
138  /// Document-wide labels SHARED by every streaming pass-2 fragment and the
139  /// spine, consulted only when `rewrite_labels` misses: the spilled content's
140  /// and the spine's id-bearing ones, built once before pass 2. Copying the
141  /// spilled index into each fragment's own map was quadratic in document size:
142  /// 28,068 labels × 459,579 segments on the 131 MB witness = 12.9 billion
143  /// String allocations. Frag-local labels still win.
144  pub rewrite_labels_shared:     Option<Rc<HashMap<String, String>>>,
145  // the following are internal "local"-based declarations in Perl
146  localized_constructed_nodes:   Vec<Vec<Node>>,
147  constructed_nodes:             Vec<Node>,
148  /// Free-list of emptied `Vec<Node>` buffers, reused across `init_constructed_nodes`
149  /// / `close_constructed_nodes` cycles. The per-body constructed-nodes frame pushes
150  /// here after its elements are drained so the next `init_constructed_nodes` can pop
151  /// a buffer with pre-existing capacity instead of heap-allocating a fresh one.
152  /// Cuts the `Vec<Node>::from_iter` hotspot that dominated absorb profiles.
153  reusable_node_buffers:         Vec<Vec<Node>>,
154  localized_boxes:               Vec<(Option<Digested>, bool)>,
155  /// Whether `box_to_absorb` never ended ([`crate::stomach::UNENDED`]), read when it was set: an
156  /// alignment is absorbed while mutably borrowed.
157  box_unended:                   bool,
158  box_to_absorb:                 Option<Digested>, // local $LaTeXML::BOX;
159  /// Transient handoff from `open_text`'s verbatim-space exception to
160  /// `open_text_internal`: whitespace-only TYPEWRITER text (verbatim
161  /// indentation / space-only verbatim lines) must be INSERTED even where
162  /// the current node needs an auto-open to reach a `#PCDATA` context —
163  /// both whitespace gates would otherwise drop it. Consumed (reset) by
164  /// `open_text_internal`.
165  verbatim_space_pending:        bool,
166  /// The font the open text node's runs were inserted with ([`Self::open_text`]), for the ligature test
167  /// when it closes. A run whose font changes only what the XML does not show — its encoding — opens no
168  /// element and would merge into a text node of another encoding: a Latin `\textLR{``q''}` run inside an
169  /// Arabic (LAE) paragraph took the paragraph's font, failed the OT1/T1 quote ligatures and kept its
170  /// grave/acute quote pairs (59r). Perl tests the parent's font (Document.pm `closeText_internal`); the
171  /// difference shows only where an encoding switch opens no element. The `usize` is the byte where the current run
172  /// starts in the node: `apply_text_ligatures` ligates from there, so a run's ligatures never reach an earlier run.
173  text_run_font:                 Option<(Node, Font, usize)>,
174  /// The text node `close_text_internal` last ligated and how many bytes of it: a return to that node (`set_node`
175  /// back after a `\label`'s float, which closed it) ligates only what is inserted after, as an open run would.
176  ligated_text:                  Option<(Node, usize)>,
177  /// Source-map (`--source-map`) cache: the current `box_to_absorb`'s
178  /// source range, captured as a plain `Copy` `Locator` at set time so
179  /// stamping never re-borrows the box's `RefCell` mid-absorb (which
180  /// panics for the mutably-borrowed `Alignment` path). Mirrors the
181  /// `box_to_absorb` save stack; `None` when source-map is off.
182  current_box_locator:           Option<Locator>,
183  localized_box_locators:        Vec<Option<Locator>>,
184  localized_fonts:               Vec<Rc<Font>>,
185  /// Streaming mode only: the store holding processed spilled segments. Set
186  /// by the streaming driver after pass 2; `serialize_into` then splices each
187  /// segment's text where its `<_spilled_ ref="N"/>` placeholder sits. `None`
188  /// on the eager path and on fragment documents.
189  spill_store:                   Option<crate::sxml::SegmentStore>,
190  /// Streaming only: RDFa prefixes USED inside spilled (freed) content,
191  /// recorded at spill time — `set_rdfa_prefixes` scans the live DOM, and
192  /// spilled usages would otherwise vanish from the root's `prefix=`.
193  extra_rdfa_prefixes:           Vec<String>,
194  /// Streaming: serialize spill placeholders LITERALLY (`<_spilled_ ref=…/>`)
195  /// instead of splicing the segment text. True during pass 1 (a spilling
196  /// ancestor must keep its children's placeholders — inlining them rebuilt
197  /// multi-GB segments: an 841 MB and a 1.85 GB one on the 131 MB witness,
198  /// and pass 2 died re-parsing them) and on pass-2 fragment docs (which
199  /// re-emit the placeholders they contain). False only at final assembly,
200  /// where the splice resolves placeholders RECURSIVELY.
201  pub literal_placeholders:      bool,
202  /// Streaming: called on each subtree as it spills, while it is still in the live DOM, so a document-wide fact that
203  /// pass 2 needs before processing any segment can be gathered from content pass 1 no longer holds (the math
204  /// parser's `d`-token evidence, `latexml_math_parser::read_differential_evidence`).
205  pub spill_observer:            Option<fn(&Document, &Node)>,
206  /// Serialize spill segments FLAT — no indentation, no decorative newlines.
207  ///
208  /// A spilled segment's text is an intermediate: pass 2 re-parses it,
209  /// processes it, and re-serializes with `serialize_aux` at the recorded
210  /// depth, and only THAT text reaches the output. The indentation pass 1 used
211  /// to emit was therefore generated, written to disk, read back, materialized
212  /// as libxml2 text nodes, deleted again by `strip_indentation_whitespace`,
213  /// and finally regenerated — pure round-trip tax.
214  ///
215  /// Measured on the 131 MB witness: **51.2% of serialized bytes are leading
216  /// whitespace + newlines** (189.4 MB of 381.5 MB sampled, 6,092,937 lines).
217  /// Over ~2.45 GB of segment text that is ~1.2 GB generated and written, read
218  /// back, and ~40M text nodes allocated in pass 2's parse — which
219  /// `strip_indentation_whitespace` then `unlink_node`s, and unlink does not
220  /// free, so they are orphaned for the fragment's lifetime.
221  ///
222  /// Set for pass 1 only. Fragment documents in pass 2 are separate `Document`s
223  /// and default to `false`, so the OUTPUT keeps its formatting exactly.
224  pub spill_flat:                bool,
225  /// Streaming pass 2 only: the fragment's ancestor `xml:id`s at spill time
226  /// (SegmentMeta::ancestors). A `label:`/`id:`-scoped rewrite whose scope
227  /// resolves to one of these covers the WHOLE fragment.
228  pub fragment_ancestor_ids:     rustc_hash::FxHashSet<String>,
229  /// The object that printed a raw counter step's number itself, by the step's serial
230  /// ([`note_raw_refstep_object`](Self::note_raw_refstep_object)): an algorithm2e line. A label after the step names
231  /// it wherever the label stands ([`float_to_label_scoped`](Self::float_to_label_scoped)).
232  raw_refstep_objects:           HashMap<i64, Node>,
233  /// The keys a `\label` has placed ([`release_earlier_label_holders`](Self::release_earlier_label_holders)).
234  placed_labels:                 rustc_hash::FxHashSet<String>,
235  /// Streaming pass 2 only: the recorded qname of the fragment's REAL parent
236  /// (SegmentMeta::parent). `finalize_rec` substitutes it for the
237  /// `ltx:_lxfragment` parse wrapper in schema decisions, so top-level
238  /// fragment content is judged against the element it will splice back
239  /// under (e.g. the empty-`ltx:text` collapse needs
240  /// `can_contain(parent, grandchild)`).
241  pub fragment_parent_qname:     Option<SymStr>,
242  /// Streaming pass 1 only: suppress the ROOT element's `after_open` hook
243  /// dispatch. Eager semantics guarantee every hook runs with digestion
244  /// COMPLETE (build starts after digestion ends); interleaving would fire
245  /// the root's hooks during fragment 1 instead — with harmful effects, not
246  /// just missed data: the frontmatter hook (`base_utilities.rs`,
247  /// `Tag!("ltx:document", after_open_late)`) would run `insert_frontmatter`
248  /// against still-EMPTY frontmatter state and mark it done, discarding the
249  /// document's abstract when the real content arrived. The streaming driver
250  /// dispatches the root's hooks exactly once, after digestion finishes.
251  defer_root_after_open:         bool,
252  /// Size of `node_boxes` after the last sweep (lowered when a spill purges
253  /// below it); the streaming sweep gate measures growth from it.
254  pub last_swept_node_boxes_len: usize,
255  /// The open run of field ink (`FieldRun`): what is being absorbed was digested from a frontmatter field's stored
256  /// tokens (their out-of-band provenance, [`Token::prov`](crate::token::Token)).
257  field_run:                     Option<FieldRun>,
258  /// The serial of the last field-ink run opened (each run's two marks carry it).
259  field_run_serial:              u32,
260  /// The nesting of [`Document::absorb`] calls while field ink is being marked (a run closes at the level it opened).
261  absorb_level:                  u32,
262  /// How many field-ink whatsits are being absorbed around the current point: what they absorb is their ink.
263  field_inherit:                 u32,
264  /// Set once the frontmatter placement settled the field ink (latexml_engine `lift_marked_field_ink`): no more
265  /// field marks after it.
266  pub field_ink_settled:         bool,
267  /// A TeX box's constructor is being absorbed and has opened no element yet ([`FIELD_BOX_PROPERTY`]): the next
268  /// [`Document::open_element`] is its own and is marked; any absorb or text before it disarms the mark.
269  field_box_pending:             bool,
270  /// The construction-time position marks made in this document ([`Document::insert_mark`]), by qualified name, each
271  /// once.
272  marks_made:                    Vec<String>,
273}
274impl Default for Document {

290/// The bookkeeping attribute (dropped at the end, as every `_` attribute) on an object a raw counter step numbered:
291/// the step's serial ([`Document::take_raw_refstep_number`], OXIDIZED_DESIGN_DIVERGENCES #813).
292pub const RAW_REFSTEP_MARK: &str = "_raw_refstep";
293
294/// Whether `node` stands inside an `ltx:Math` (a box in an `ltx:XMText`: `\text{\begin{tcolorbox}…}`): math is
295/// rendered as one formula, so an id there names no object the HTML keeps and a label there would dangle
296/// ([`Document::float_to_label_for`]; review probes rev78g3 tbx.tex, tbx3.tex; repro
297/// `cross-references/math_box_label_climbs_to_the_display.tex`).
298fn within_math(node: &Node) -> bool {
299  let mut parent = node.get_parent();
300  while let Some(current) = parent {
301    if current.get_type() != Some(NodeType::ElementNode) {
302      return false;
303    }
304    if get_node_qname(&current) == pin!("ltx:Math") {
305      return true;
306    }
307    parent = current.get_parent();
308  }
309  false
310}

312/// The target of the processing instructions marking a run of a frontmatter field's ink (`FieldRun`):
313/// construction-time scaffolding, never in the output (the engine's frontmatter placement removes them; the finalize

315pub const FIELD_MARK_TARGET: &str = "ltx-field-mark";

317/// Has this conversion stamped any token with a field provenance (latexml_engine `\lx@field@mark`)? Only a gate:
318/// while false, [`Document::absorb`] does no field-ink work at all. Cleared at every conversion's start
319/// ([`reset_field_provenance`]).
320#[thread_local]
321static FIELD_PROV_STAMPED: std::cell::Cell<bool> = std::cell::Cell::new(false);
322/// Note that a field's stored tokens now carry their provenance (`FIELD_PROV_STAMPED`).
323pub fn note_field_prov_stamped() { FIELD_PROV_STAMPED.set(true); }
324/// The `FIELD_PROV_STAMPED` gate as it stands (to put it back after a rehearsal the document never keeps,
325/// [`FieldLedgerScope`](crate::token::FieldLedgerScope)).
326pub fn field_prov_stamped() -> bool { FIELD_PROV_STAMPED.get() }
327/// Put the `FIELD_PROV_STAMPED` gate back as [`field_prov_stamped`] read it.
328pub fn restore_field_prov_stamped(stamped: bool) { FIELD_PROV_STAMPED.set(stamped); }
329/// Clear the `FIELD_PROV_STAMPED` gate (conversion start).
330pub fn reset_field_prov_stamped() { FIELD_PROV_STAMPED.set(false); }
331/// Reset every piece of a conversion's field-provenance thread state (OXIDIZED_DESIGN #715): the stamped gate, the
332/// field ledger and its settled flag, the pending cover. Run at the start of every conversion (the converter's
333/// `reset_conversion_state`, at `initialize_report`), whatever the thread converted before: a persistent `cortex_worker` thread, a streaming restart
334/// and the CLI's supplements convert on one thread without an engine reset, and a ledger settled by the previous
335/// document recorded nothing for the next one, which then lifted no print at all (review r4 finding 1).
336pub fn reset_field_provenance() {
337  reset_field_prov_stamped();
338  crate::token::reset_field_cover_pending();
339}

363/// The box property of a Warning that belongs to the box's print, not to its digestion ([`absorb_warning`]): raised
364/// when [`Document::absorb`] takes the box (a [`Tbox`] or a whatsit) into the document, once per key. A box digested and
365/// never absorbed — measured (`\settowidth`), saved and never used (`\sbox`), made by a rehearsal or a speculative
366/// digestion, or under a [`DiagnosticsHold`](crate::util::logger::DiagnosticsHold) it discards — raises nothing and
367/// leaves no key set, so the box the document prints still raises it. An undecodable math glyph's once-per-font
368/// Warning (latexml_engine sect08.rs `undecodable_math_slot`, OXIDIZED_DESIGN_DIVERGENCES #27).
369pub const ABSORB_WARNING_PROPERTY: &str = "absorbWarning";
370// `pin!` takes a literal: [`raise_absorb_warning`]'s lookup spells the name, tied to the constant here.
371const _: () = assert!(matches!(
372  ABSORB_WARNING_PROPERTY.as_bytes(),
373  b"absorbWarning"
374));
375/// The source position, recorded at digestion, at which a constructor's [`ABSORB_WARNING_PROPERTY`] Warning is raised:
376/// the gullet's as the constructor's arguments are read (core `dialect::transfer_common_constructor_options`), the
377/// position a [`Tbox`] carries as its locator. A whatsit's own locator is set only under `--source-map`.
378pub const ABSORB_WARNING_LOCATOR_PROPERTY: &str = "absorbWarningLocator";
379const _: () = assert!(matches!(
380  ABSORB_WARNING_LOCATOR_PROPERTY.as_bytes(),
381  b"absorbWarningLocator"
382));
383
384/// The [`ABSORB_WARNING_PROPERTY`] value of `Warning:<category>:<object> <message>`, raised once per `once_key`: the
385/// first absorbed box carrying the key raises it, the key is then set (a global state value, as the text side's once
386/// keys are), and every later one is silent.
387pub fn absorb_warning(once_key: &str, category: &str, object: &str, message: &str) -> Stored {
388  Stored::Strings(Rc::from([
389    arena::pin(once_key),
390    arena::pin(category),
391    arena::pin(object),
392    arena::pin(message),
393  ]))
394}
395
396/// Raise the [`ABSORB_WARNING_PROPERTY`] Warning `object` carries, if its key is not yet set; the one place the key is
397/// set. Looked up by its cached symbol and without a copy of the map: this runs for every box absorbed.
398fn raise_absorb_warning(object: &Digested) {
399  let Some((warning, recorded)) =
400    object.with_properties(|props| match props.get_sym(pin!("absorbWarning")) {
401      Some(Stored::Strings(warning)) => Some((
402        Rc::clone(warning),
403        match props.get_sym(pin!("absorbWarningLocator")) {
404          Some(Stored::Locator(locator)) => Some(**locator),
405          _ => None,
406        },
407      )),
408      _ => None,
409    })
410  else {
411    return;
412  };
413  let [key, category, name, message] = *warning else {
414    return;
415  };
416  if state::lookup_bool_sym(key) {
417    return;
418  }
419  state::assign_value(&arena::to_string(key), true, Some(state::Scope::Global));
420  // At the box's source position, where it was digested: a constructor's recorded one
421  // ([`ABSORB_WARNING_LOCATOR_PROPERTY`]), else the box's locator (a Tbox's). The gullet's, at build time, is the
422  // document's end.
423  let location = recorded
424    .or_else(|| object.get_locator())
425    .map_or_else(crate::gullet::get_location, |locator| s!("at {locator}"));
426  emit_warn(
427    &arena::to_string(category),
428    &arena::to_string(name),
429    &s!(
430      "{}\n\t{location}\n\tIn {}:{}:{}\n",
431      arena::to_string(message),
432      file!(),
433      line!(),
434      column!()
435    ),
436  );
437}

439/// Can a box digested now still matter to a frontmatter field's print (the field ledger not settled)? The gate of
440/// every digest-time field-box mark, checked before anything else is looked up. It does not wait for a field to be
441/// stamped: a header box may be digested before the document declares its `\title` (fms1 round-6 review finding 1);
442/// [`Document::mark_field_box`] applies the stamp at absorb time.
443#[inline]
444pub fn field_box_marks_live() -> bool { crate::token::field_ledger_live() }
445
446/// Mark `whatsit` as a TeX box's constructor ([`FIELD_BOX_PROPERTY`]), while a field's print can still be lifted.
447pub fn field_box_whatsit(whatsit: &mut crate::whatsit::Whatsit) {
448  if field_box_marks_live() {
449    whatsit.set_property(FIELD_BOX_PROPERTY, true);
450  }
451}
452
453/// The box property of an alignment's whatsit holding the field-ledger serials of the row-end markers its body
454/// consumed (a field value's `\\`, [`field_ink_taken_serials`]): taken when the document absorbs the whatsit.
455pub const FIELD_TAKEN_PROPERTY: &str = "fieldTaken";
456
457/// The field-ledger serials of the boxes in `digested` (an alignment's row-end marker, a value's `\\`, latexml_engine
458/// `digest_alignment_body`), pushed onto `serials`: the structure the print is set in consumes them, never absorbed.
459/// The alignment keeps them on its whatsit ([`FIELD_TAKEN_PROPERTY`]), and they are noted taken
460/// ([`field_ledger_take`](crate::token::field_ledger_take)) only when [`Document::absorb`] absorbs that whatsit, so
461/// the run of ink the row ends may cover them and no other run does; an alignment never shown (in an unused
462/// `\setbox`, `\sbox`, `{lrbox}`) takes nothing (OXIDIZED_DESIGN #715; review r4 finding 2, probes s25, s27, s28).
463pub fn field_ink_taken_serials(digested: &Digested, serials: &mut Vec<u32>) {
464  if !FIELD_PROV_STAMPED.get() || !crate::token::field_ledger_live() {
465    return;
466  }
467  for item in digested.unlist() {
468    if matches!(item.data(), DigestedData::List(_)) {
469      field_ink_taken_serials(&item, serials);
470    } else if let Some(serial) =
471      item.with_properties(|props| match props.get_sym(pin!("fieldSerial")) {
472        Some(Stored::Int(serial)) => u32::try_from(*serial).ok(),
473        _ => None,
474      })
475    {
476      serials.push(serial);
477    }
478  }
479}
480
481/// A run of one frontmatter field's ink being absorbed: boxes digested from that field's stored tokens, one after the
482/// other at one absorb level, in the order of the value (a box whose cover ends at or before the start of a box the run
483/// holds reads the value again and begins a new print: `\StrLeft{\@title}{3}\@title` is two runs). It opens with `<?ltx-field-mark begin <field> <id>?>`
484/// where its first box goes and closes with `<?ltx-field-mark end <field> <id> <serials>?>` after its last (`<serials>`:
485/// the field-ledger serials of the boxes it absorbed, `first:last` intervals joined by `,`,
486/// [`field_ledger_cover`](crate::token::field_ledger_cover), so the engine can tell a whole print from a fragment by
487/// every position of the value its own boxes consumed, its structure's tokens too). The two marks of a run carry its
488/// id: they pair by construction, never with another print's (OXIDIZED_DESIGN #715).
489#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
490struct FieldRun {
491  field:     u16,
492  id:        u32,
493  level:     u32,
494  /// the serials of the boxes absorbed, as inclusive intervals in absorption order
495  serials:   Vec<(u32, u32)>,
496  /// the highest position a box of the run starts at
497  max_start: u16,
498}
499
500impl FieldRun {
501  /// Note that the run absorbed the box recorded with `serial` (a box used twice is in each run that absorbs it).
502  fn take(&mut self, serial: u32) {
503    match self.serials.last_mut() {
504      Some((first, last)) if *first <= serial && serial <= *last + 1 => *last = (*last).max(serial),
505      _ => self.serials.push((serial, serial)),
506    }
507  }
508}

510/// Element names whose closed instances may be spilled from ROOT level.
511/// Leading non-sectional root children (title, creators, abstract, resources)
512/// must stay live: the frontmatter fallback and `maybe_promote_leading_title`
513/// operate on them at end-of-build (`base_utilities.rs`).

567/// Attachment policy for `Document::add_comment`. Kept module-local.
568enum Placement_ {
569  AppendChild,
570  PrevSibling,
571}
572
573/// Whether `node`'s subtree (itself included) holds a paragraph with visible
574/// text outside any picture: `descendant-or-self::ltx:p[not(ancestor::ltx:picture)]
575/// [.//text()[normalize-space()][not(ancestor::ltx:picture)]]`, walked with an
576/// early exit instead of collecting every match. The streaming spill asks it for
577/// every resident root child on every yield (roadmap stream C, 2026-09-25).
578fn subtree_holds_prose(node: &Node) -> bool {
579  fn is_ltx(node: &Node, local: &str) -> bool {
580    node.get_type() == Some(NodeType::ElementNode)
581      && node.get_name() == local
582      && node
583        .get_namespace()
584        .is_some_and(|ns| ns.get_href() == model::LTX_NAMESPACE)
585  }
586  fn text_outside_pictures(node: &Node) -> bool {
587    let mut child = node.get_first_child();
588    while let Some(c) = child {
589      let holds = match c.get_type() {
590        // `normalize-space()` strips XML whitespace only (#x20 #x9 #xD #xA),
591        // so a no-break space is visible text.
592        Some(NodeType::TextNode | NodeType::CDataSectionNode) => c
593          .get_content()
594          .contains(|ch: char| !matches!(ch, ' ' | '\t' | '\r' | '\n')),
595        Some(NodeType::ElementNode) => !is_ltx(&c, "picture") && text_outside_pictures(&c),
596        _ => false,
597      };
598      if holds {
599        return true;
600      }
601      child = c.get_next_sibling();
602    }
603    false
604  }
605  fn walk(node: &Node) -> bool {
606    if node.get_type() != Some(NodeType::ElementNode) || is_ltx(node, "picture") {
607      return false;
608    }
609    if is_ltx(node, "p") && text_outside_pictures(node) {
610      return true;
611    }
612    let mut child = node.get_first_child();
613    while let Some(c) = child {
614      if walk(&c) {
615        return true;
616      }
617      child = c.get_next_sibling();
618    }
619    false
620  }
621  let mut up = node.get_parent();
622  while let Some(a) = up {
623    if is_ltx(&a, "picture") {
624      return false;
625    }
626    up = a.get_parent();
627  }
628  walk(node)
629}

631impl Document {
632  pub fn new() -> Self {
633    crate::ensure_libxml_init(); // Thread-safe libxml2 initialization
634    // Node-mutation aliasing is enforced by libxml's `Node::node_ptr_mut`
635    // (`RefCell::try_borrow_mut`, libxml >= 0.3.14): it rejects only an *active*
636    // re-entrant borrow, not a high `Rc::strong_count` from benign clones. The
637    // former `set_node_rc_guard(8192)` band-aid — which raised a clone-count
638    // threshold to stop spurious "shared Node" errors on deeply-shared docs
639    // (e.g. arxiv 0805.2376 dcpic) — is no longer needed. See WISDOM.md #46.
640    let doc_scaffold = XmlDoc::new().unwrap();
641    let root = match doc_scaffold.get_root_element() {
642      Some(root) => root,
643      None => doc_scaffold.as_node(), // when empty, set the document node as a node.
644    };
645    Document {
646      document:                    doc_scaffold,
647      node:                        root,
648      node_boxes:                  HashMap::default(),
649      node_fonts:                  HashMap::default(),
650      idstore:                     HashMap::default(),
651      spilled_ids:                 rustc_hash::FxHashSet::default(),
652      spill_anchors:               rustc_hash::FxHashSet::default(),
653      spilled_anchor_counters:     rustc_hash::FxHashMap::default(),
654      fragment_anchor_id:          None,
655      svg_ids:                     rustc_hash::FxHashSet::default(),
656      svg_id_suffixes:             rustc_hash::FxHashMap::default(),
657      spilled_ns_prefixes:         rustc_hash::FxHashSet::default(),
658      rewrite_labels:              HashMap::default(),
659      rewrite_labels_shared:       None,
660      pending:                     Vec::new(),
661      localized_constructed_nodes: Vec::new(),
662      constructed_nodes:           Vec::new(),
663      reusable_node_buffers:       Vec::new(),
664      box_to_absorb:               None,
665      verbatim_space_pending:      false,
666      text_run_font:               None,
667      ligated_text:                None,
668      current_box_locator:         None,
669      localized_box_locators:      Vec::new(),
670      context:                     None,
671      localized_boxes:             Vec::new(),
672      box_unended:                 false,
673      localized_fonts:             Vec::new(),
674      spill_store:                 None,
675      extra_rdfa_prefixes:         Vec::new(),
676      literal_placeholders:        false,
677      spill_observer:              None,
678      spill_flat:                  false,
679      fragment_ancestor_ids:       rustc_hash::FxHashSet::default(),
680      raw_refstep_objects:         HashMap::default(),
681      placed_labels:               rustc_hash::FxHashSet::default(),
682      fragment_parent_qname:       None,
683      defer_root_after_open:       false,
684      last_swept_node_boxes_len:   0,
685      field_run:                   None,
686      field_run_serial:            0,
687      absorb_level:                0,
688      field_inherit:               0,
689      field_ink_settled:           false,
690      field_box_pending:           false,
691      marks_made:                  Vec::new(),
692    }
693  }

695  /// Wrap an existing XML document (a streamed fragment from
696  /// [`crate::sxml::FragmentReader`]) as a `Document`, so the pass-2 phases —
697  /// rewrites, math parsing, per-fragment finalize — run on it with the same
698  /// machinery the eager path uses. The insertion point starts at the root;
699  /// the idstore is rebuilt from the fragment's own `xml:id`s; `node_fonts`
700  /// is seeded by the caller (the hash→Font table is conversion-global and
701  /// pointer-free, so sharing its contents is safe).
702  pub fn from_xml_document(doc: XmlDoc, node_fonts: HashMap<u64, Font>) -> Result<Self> {
703    crate::ensure_libxml_init();
704    let node = match doc.get_root_element() {
705      Some(root) => root,
706      None => doc.as_node(),
707    };
708    let mut document = Document {
709      document: doc,
710      node,
711      node_fonts,
712      ..Document::new_empty_fields()
713    };
714    if let Some(root) = document.document.get_root_element() {
715      document.record_node_ids(&root)?;
716    }
717    Ok(document)
718  }
719
720  /// The all-empty field set shared by [`Document::new`] and
721  /// [`Document::from_xml_document`] (functional-update base; the caller
722  /// overrides `document`/`node`/`node_fonts`). Not public: an empty scaffold
723  /// with a dangling default `node` is not a usable document on its own.
724  fn new_empty_fields() -> Self { Self::new() }
725
726  /// Get the element at (or containing) the current insertion point.
727  pub fn get_element(&self) -> Option<Node> {
728    let mut node = &self.node;
729    let parent = node.get_parent();
730    if node.get_type() == Some(NodeType::TextNode) {
731      node = parent.as_ref().unwrap();
732    }
733    let final_type = node.get_type();
734    if final_type.is_none() || final_type == Some(NodeType::DocumentNode) {
735      None
736    } else {
737      Some(node.clone())
738    }
739  }
740
741  /// Find the nodes according to the given `xpath` expression,
742  /// the xpath is relative to $node (if given), otherwise to the document node.
743  pub fn findnodes(&mut self, xpath: &str, node_opt: Option<&Node>) -> Vec<Node> {
744    let node = match node_opt {
745      Some(node) => Cow::Borrowed(node),
746      None => match self.document.get_root_element() {
747        Some(root) => Cow::Owned(root),
748        None => return Vec::new(),
749      },
750    };
751    self.get_xpath().findnodes(xpath, Some(&node))
752  }
753
754  /// Get an XPath context that knows about our namespace mappings.
755  pub fn get_xpath(&mut self) -> &mut XPath {
756    if let Some(ref mut ctxt) = self.context {
757      ctxt
758    } else {
759      let mut context = XPath::new(&self.document, HashMap::default());
760      model::with_code_namespaces(|code_ns| {
761        for (prefix, ns) in code_ns {
762          // TODO: Is this too slow? We may need to store an active context in the state as an
763          // alternative
764          arena::with2(*prefix, *ns, |p_str, ns_str| {
765            context
766              .register_namespace(p_str, ns_str)
767              .expect("register_namespace has no reason to fail during get_xpath?");
768          });
769        }
770      });
771      self.context = Some(context);
772      self.context.as_mut().unwrap()
773    }
774  }
775
776  /// Like findnodes, but only returns the first matched node
777  pub fn findnode(&mut self, xpath: &str, node: Option<&Node>) -> Option<Node> {
778    let mut nodes = self.get_xpath().findnodes(xpath, node);
779    if nodes.is_empty() {
780      None
781    } else {
782      Some(nodes.remove(0))
783    }
784  }
785
786  /// Like findnodes, but expects an xpath that evaluates to a literal value (e.g. for attributes)
787  pub fn findvalues(&mut self, xpath: &str, node_opt: Option<&Node>) -> Vec<String> {
788    match node_opt {
789      Some(node) => self.get_xpath().findvalues(xpath, Some(node)),
790      None => match self.document.get_root_element() {
791        Some(root) => self.get_xpath().findvalues(xpath, Some(&root)),
792        _ => Vec::new(),
793      },
794    }
795  }
796
797  /// The current insertion point: the node that absorbed content is appended
798  /// to, and the one [`open_element`](Self::open_element) opens beneath.
799  /// Perl's `$document->getNode`.
800  pub fn get_node(&self) -> &Node { &self.node }
801  pub fn get_node_mut(&mut self) -> &mut Node { &mut self.node }
802
803  pub fn get_document(&self) -> &XmlDoc { &self.document }
804  pub fn get_document_mut(&mut self) -> &mut XmlDoc { &mut self.document }
805
806  // **********************************************************************
807  // This should be called before returning the final XML::LibXML::Document to the
808  // outside world.  It resolves the fonts for each node relative to it's
809  // ancestors. It removes the `helper' attributes that store fonts, source
810  // box, etc.
811  pub fn finalize(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
812    // Belt-and-suspenders idstore rebuild before prune_xmduals.
813    // Originally guarded a SIGSEGV on arxiv 1605.08055 where
814    // `mark_xmnode_visibility` dereferenced dangling lookup_id
815    // entries while recursing through XMRef nodes. Cycle 72 audited
816    // the 5 hazard call sites the earlier comment listed (math-parser
817    // `replace_tree` at parser.rs:456/690, `unbind_node` loops at
818    // parser.rs:639/856 and rewrite.rs:522); all 5 now have proper
819    // unrecord_node_ids / remove_node-cascade coverage. The rebuild
820    // call is retained as a safety net pending empirical
821    // 10k-sandbox verification on 1605.08055 — see SYNC_STATUS.md
822    // D3b [~] entry. A fresh DOM walk drops any surviving dangling
823    // entries; duplicates in DOM get modify_id via record_node_ids.
824    self.rebuild_idstore_from_dom()?;
825    // Sweep dangling XMRefs that were specifically created by
826    // amsmath::rearrange_ams_split (tagged with `_split_ref="1"`).
827    // The math parser later absorbs some XMArray cells (inserted
828    // MULOPs, etc.) and the parallel XMWrap refs end up pointing
829    // at vanished targets, cascading through Warning:expected:node
830    // (here) and Error:expected:id (post-process) for ~1500 wp3
831    // canvas papers. Restricting the sweep to `_split_ref` avoids
832    // breaking declare_test's renamed-id case (XMRefs pointing to
833    // `S1.Ex1.m1.1`-style ids that resolve through Perl-faithful
834    // idstore staleness; those don't carry the marker).
835    self.prune_dangling_split_xmrefs()?;
836    self.prune_xmduals()?;
837    if let Some(mut root) = self.document.get_root_element() {
838      self.set_local_font(Rc::new(Font::text_default()));
839      self.finalize_rec(&mut root)?;
840      self.set_rdfa_prefixes();
841      self.apply_document_namespace_declarations(&mut root);
842      self.expire_local_font();
843    }
844    Ok(())
845  }
846
847  /// [`finalize`](Self::finalize) restricted to one subtree: resolve fonts
848  /// against ancestors and strip the `_font`/`_autoopened`/… bookkeeping
849  /// attributes, without the document-level passes (idstore rebuild, XMDual
850  /// pruning, RDFa/namespace declarations) that only make sense for a complete
851  /// document.
852  ///
853  /// Used by `latexml_post::make_bibliography` to render a `.bib` field value
854  /// into an XML fragment through the real engine: it absorbs into a scratch
855  /// `ltx:text` wrapper and serializes that wrapper's children.
856  ///
857  /// Whole-document [`finalize`](Self::finalize) cannot serve that caller —
858  /// **not** because it errors (it returns `Ok`), but because running
859  /// `finalize_rec` from the ROOT legitimately UNWRAPS a redundant font-only
860  /// `ltx:text`: measured on such a scratch document, the content survives at
861  /// the root while the caller's wrapper handle is left detached and childless
862  /// (`wrapper_children 1 -> 0`, `parent = None`), so it serializes to nothing.
863  /// Starting the recursion AT the wrapper keeps it addressable.
864  pub fn finalize_subtree(&mut self, node: &mut Node) -> Result<()> {
865    self.finalize_subtree_in(node, Font::text_default())
866  }
867
868  /// [`finalize_subtree`](Self::finalize_subtree) under `context`, the font declared around the subtree (a streamed
869  /// segment's [`SegmentMeta::font`](crate::sxml::SegmentMeta)).
870  pub fn finalize_subtree_in(&mut self, node: &mut Node, context: Font) -> Result<()> {
871    self.set_local_font(Rc::new(context));
872    let result = self.finalize_rec(node);
873    self.expire_local_font();
874    result
875  }
876
877  /// Apply registered document namespace declarations to the root element.
878  /// Perl's RegisterDocumentNamespace stores prefix→URI mappings in the model.
879  /// These must appear as xmlns:prefix="URI" on the root element during serialization.
880  /// Only emit namespaces that are actually used in the document (Perl behavior).
881  fn apply_document_namespace_declarations(&self, root: &mut Node) {
882    let prefixes = model::get_document_namespace_prefixes();
883    // Collect which prefixes are actually used in the document
884    let nsnodes = root.get_namespace_declarations();
885    let existing_prefixes: Vec<String> = nsnodes.iter().map(|ns| ns.get_prefix()).collect();
886    // Skip internal/default namespaces, namespaces containing "DEFAULT#" (internal model
887    // entries), and prefixes already declared on root.
888    let wanted = |prefix: &str, ns_uri: &str| {
889      !(prefix.is_empty() || prefix == "ltx" || prefix == "xml")
890        && !ns_uri.contains("DEFAULT#")
891        && !existing_prefixes.iter().any(|p| p == prefix)
892    };
893    // Whether a descendant uses the prefix — on the resident DOM, or inside a subtree that
894    // streaming pass 1 spilled to disk before this pass ran (`spilled_ns_prefixes`). One walk
895    // answers for every prefix the spill does not.
896    let to_find: Vec<&str> = prefixes
897      .iter()
898      .filter(|(prefix, ns_uri)| {
899        wanted(prefix, ns_uri) && !self.spilled_ns_prefixes.contains(prefix)
900      })
901      .map(|(prefix, _)| prefix.as_str())
902      .collect();
903    let in_use = namespace_prefixes_in_use(root, &to_find);
904    for (prefix, ns_uri) in &prefixes {
905      if !wanted(prefix, ns_uri) {
906        continue;
907      }
908      if self.spilled_ns_prefixes.contains(prefix) || in_use.contains(prefix.as_str()) {
909        let attr_name = format!("xmlns:{prefix}");
910        root.set_attribute(&attr_name, ns_uri).ok();
911      }
912    }
913  }
914
915  /// Remove xml:ids from XMTok elements that aren't referenced by any idref.
916  /// The Rust math parser generates xml:ids on XMTok nodes for internal XMRef linkage
917  /// during parsing. After finalization (which includes prune_xmduals), some ids
918  /// are no longer referenced. Perl's parser doesn't generate these ids.
919  pub fn cleanup_unreferenced_xmtok_ids(&mut self) {
920    use rustc_hash::FxHashSet as HashSet;
921    let mut referenced_ids: HashSet<String> = HashSet::default();
922    for node in self.findnodes("descendant-or-self::*[@idref]", None) {
923      if let Some(idref) = node.get_attribute("idref") {
924        referenced_ids.insert(idref);
925      }
926    }
927    let xml_ns = "http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace";
928    let toks = self.findnodes("descendant-or-self::ltx:XMTok[@xml:id]", None);
929    for mut tok in toks {
930      if let Some(id) = tok.get_attribute_ns("id", xml_ns)
931        && !referenced_ids.contains(&id)
932      {
933        self.unrecord_id(&id);
934        // Remove both the prefixed attribute and the ns attribute
935        let _ = tok.remove_attribute("xml:id");
936        let _ = tok.remove_attribute_ns("id", xml_ns);
937      }
938    }
939  }
940
941  /// Iterative implementation of finalize_rec to avoid stack overflow.
942  /// Uses an explicit heap-allocated work stack instead of call-stack recursion.
943  /// Resolves fonts for each node relative to its ancestors, and removes
944  /// helper attributes (_font, _standalone_font, etc).
945  fn finalize_rec(&mut self, node: &mut Node) -> Result<()> {
946    // Work items for the iterative traversal.
947    // Enter: process font declarations and children (text children handled inline,
948    //        element children deferred to the stack).
949    // PostElement: after finalizing an element child, check for font wrapper collapse.
950    // PostWork: after all children processed, remove bookkeeping attrs and expire font.
951    #[allow(clippy::enum_variant_names)]
952    enum Work {
953      Enter(Node),
954      PostElement {
955        child:         Node,
956        parent_qname:  SymStr,
957        was_forcefont: bool,
958      },
959      PostWork {
960        node: Node,
961      },
962    }
963
964    let mut stack: Vec<Work> = Vec::new();
965    // Track nodes that have no visible attributes after bookkeeping removal.
966    // Used in PostElement to decide collapse without calling get_attributes()
967    // (which can crash on corrupted libxml2 attribute lists after replace_node).
968    let mut empty_attr_nodes: HashSet<usize> = HashSet::default();
969    // Defer collapse operations to avoid libxml2 memory corruption.
970    // Collapsing nodes during tree traversal corrupts attribute linked lists
971    // of ancestor nodes. By collecting collapses and running them after
972    // the entire traversal completes, we avoid accessing corrupted state.
973    let mut deferred_collapses: Vec<(Node, SymStr)> = Vec::new();
974    // The text font declared around each open `ltx:Math`, innermost last: an `XMText` in it is text, set in that font
975    // (see the reset at `ltx:Math` below).
976    let mut math_outer_fonts: Vec<Rc<Font>> = Vec::new();
977    stack.push(Work::Enter(node.clone()));
978
979    while let Some(work) = stack.pop() {
980      match work {
981        Work::Enter(mut current) => {
982          let raw_qname = get_node_qname(&current);
983          // Streaming pass 2: judge the fragment's parse wrapper as the REAL
984          // parent it splices back under, so schema decisions for top-level
985          // fragment content match the eager walk (see the field docs).
986          let qname = match self.fragment_parent_qname {
987            Some(parent) if raw_qname == pin!("ltx:_lxfragment") => parent,
988            _ => raw_qname,
989          };
990          let local_font = self.get_local_font().unwrap();
991          // _standalone_font is typically for metadata that gets extracted out of context
992          let mut declared_font = if current.has_attribute("_standalone_font") {
993            Cow::Borrowed(&*FONT_TEXT_DEFAULT)
994          } else {
995            Cow::Borrowed(&*local_font)
996          };
997          // An `XMText` (`\text`, `\mbox` in a formula) is set in the text font around the formula (amstext's `\text`
998          // takes `\f@family`, `\f@series`, `\f@shape`), so its content is written against that, as Perl writes it.
999          if qname == pin!("ltx:XMText")
1000            && let Some(outer) = math_outer_fonts.last()
1001          {
1002            let mut text_context = declared_font.into_owned();
1003            text_context.family.clone_from(&outer.family);
1004            text_context.series.clone_from(&outer.series);
1005            text_context.shape.clone_from(&outer.shape);
1006            declared_font = Cow::Owned(text_context);
1007          }
1008
1009          // TODO: _pre_comment / _comment insertion requires create_comment support in libxml
1010          // wrapper Perl: parent.insertBefore(XML::LibXML::Comment.new(comment), node)
1011          // Perl: parent.insertAfter(XML::LibXML::Comment.new(comment), node)
1012
1013          // Use boxed HashMap to reduce work item size — Font is ~500 bytes per entry
1014          let mut pending_declaration: Box<HashMap<String, (String, Font)>> = Box::default();
1015
1016          if self.has_node_font(&current) {
1017            let desired_font = self.get_node_font(&current);
1018            *pending_declaration = desired_font.relative_to(&declared_font);
1019            if (current.get_first_child().is_some() || current.has_attribute("_force_font"))
1020              && !pending_declaration.is_empty()
1021            {
1022              let mut keys_to_remove: Vec<SymStr> = Vec::new();
1023              let mut attrs_to_set: Vec<(SymStr, SymStr)> = Vec::new();
1024              for (key, (value, properties)) in pending_declaration.iter() {
1025                if model::can_have_attribute(qname, arena::pin(key)) {
1026                  let key_sym = arena::pin(key);
1027                  attrs_to_set.push((key_sym, arena::pin(value)));
1028                  // Merge to set the font currently in effect
1029                  declared_font = Cow::Owned(declared_font.merge_ref(properties));
1030                  keys_to_remove.push(key_sym);
1031                }
1032              }
1033
1034              for (key, mut value) in attrs_to_set {
1035                if key == pin!("class") {
1036                  // Merge and sort class values alphabetically, matching Perl's behavior
1037                  if let Some(ovalue) = current.get_attribute("class") {
1038                    let new_s = arena::with(value, |s| s.to_string());
1039                    let mut classes: Vec<&str> = new_s
1040                      .split_whitespace()
1041                      .chain(ovalue.split_whitespace())
1042                      .collect();
1043                    classes.sort_unstable();
1044                    classes.dedup();
1045                    value = arena::pin(classes.join(" "));
1046                  }
1047                }
1048                // Resolve to owned Strings before calling set_attribute,
1049                // to avoid holding an arena borrow while set_attribute may need arena::pin
1050                // for schema-based attribute filtering (canHaveAttribute check).
1051                let key_s = arena::with(key, |s| s.to_string());
1052                let value_s = arena::with(value, |s| s.to_string());
1053                self.set_attribute(&mut current, &key_s, &value_s)?;
1054              }
1055              for key in keys_to_remove {
1056                arena::with(key, |key_str| pending_declaration.remove(key_str));
1057              }
1058            }
1059          }
1060          // Optionally add ids to all nodes (AFTER all parsing, rearrangement, etc)
1061          // (gate on the RAW name: a fragment wrapper standing in for its
1062          // real parent must not mint an id — it is never serialized).
1063          if raw_qname != pin!("ltx:document")
1064            && raw_qname != pin!("ltx:_lxfragment")
1065            && state::lookup_bool("GENERATE_IDS")
1066            && !current.has_attribute("xml:id")
1067            && !current.has_attribute("id") // SVG elements with plain id don't need xml:id
1068            && arena::with(qname, |qname_str| can_have_attribute(qname_str, "xml:id"))
1069          {
1070            self.generate_id(&mut current, "")?;
1071          }
1072          // A measured foreignObject declares its font size: its style's `font-size` anchor (tex_box.rs), carried in
1073          // `_font_anchor`, so its content's `fontsize` is relative to that, not to the size declared around the
1074          // picture — a `\footnotesize` figure's node text was shrunk twice (KNOWN_PERL_ERRORS #439; witness
1075          // tests/tikz/consort-flowchart).
1076          if let Some(anchor) = current.get_attribute("_font_anchor") {
1077            let size = anchor.parse::<f64>().unwrap_or(10.0);
1078            declared_font = Cow::Owned(declared_font.merge_ref(&Font {
1079              size: Some(size),
1080              ..Font::default()
1081            }));
1082            pending_declaration.remove("fontsize");
1083          }
1084          // A formula's fonts are the math fonts (fontmath.ltx's math versions), never the text family, series or
1085          // shape around it: `$y$` in `\emph` of a sans document is CMMI10, `\mathsf{G}` in `\textit` CMSS10. So its
1086          // tokens are written relative to the text default's family, series and shape (size and colour do reach
1087          // math), not to the enclosing text element as Perl's finalize_rec does (Document.pm:385-410) — against
1088          // a `sansserif italic` `\emph` the italic `y` was written `font="serif"`, which MathML reads whole
1089          // (MathML.pm:677) as upright: 2608.14133 (1,890 letters), 2608.31026, 2605.03549, 2604.00146,
1090          // 2607.19982, 2606.05381, 2604.16675; `\textsf{\emph{$y$}}` in Perl too (KNOWN_PERL_ERRORS #1002). The
1091          // MathML side reads the context font from inside the formula only (`math_context_font`). An `XMText` in it
1092          // returns to the text font (above). OXIDIZED_DESIGN_DIVERGENCES #780; guards
1093          // `perfect_kernel_batch77u::math_fonts_*`.
1094          if qname == pin!("ltx:Math") {
1095            math_outer_fonts.push(Rc::new(declared_font.clone().into_owned()));
1096            let mut math_context = declared_font.into_owned();
1097            math_context.family.clone_from(&FONT_TEXT_DEFAULT.family);
1098            math_context.series.clone_from(&FONT_TEXT_DEFAULT.series);
1099            math_context.shape.clone_from(&FONT_TEXT_DEFAULT.shape);
1100            declared_font = Cow::Owned(math_context);
1101          }
1102          self.set_local_font(Rc::new(declared_font.into_owned()));
1103
1104          // Process children using the snapshot from get_child_nodes().
1105          // Element children are deferred to the stack; text children are handled inline.
1106          // PostWork is pushed first (runs after all children), then children in reverse.
1107          //
1108          // No attribute snapshot is taken here: PostWork deliberately
1109          // re-derives the bookkeeping set at its own time (see the comment
1110          // there — descendant `generate_id` calls write `_ID_counter_*` onto
1111          // this node AFTER Enter). Capturing it here cost a full
1112          // `get_attributes()` HashMap plus a String per attribute on every
1113          // node — ~10M nodes on the streaming witness — and the result was
1114          // never read.
1115          stack.push(Work::PostWork { node: current.clone() });
1116
1117          // Leftover `*_Capture_` wrappers/markers (`ltx:_Capture_`, the frontmatter
1118          // position marker `ltx:_Frontmatter_Capture_`) are construction-time
1119          // scaffolding that a document ending abnormally (a Fatal, `\end{document}`
1120          // swallowed by an unbalanced conditional, a streaming spill) can strand in
1121          // the tree; the schema admits them nowhere ("not allowed anywhere"). Unwrap
1122          // the ones with content, drop the empty ones, then snapshot the children.
1123          // ONE pass over the direct children only — no re-scan after an unwrap and
1124          // no `_CaptureBlock_`: under streaming a fragment is finalized MID-BUILD
1125          // (spill threshold 3 in `114_streaming_*`), when an `insert_frontmatter`
1126          // `_Capture_` wrapper or an `insert_block` box capture can be legitimately
1127          // live; chasing wrappers exposed by an unwrap re-ordered faketitlepage's
1128          // abstract above its titlepage. One `ends_with` per child on the common
1129          // no-scrap path (this is the streaming hot path — see the
1130          // `get_attributes` note above). `_lxfragment` is not one.
1131          // The engine's field marks (processing instructions, [`FIELD_MARK_TARGET`]) are scaffolding too.
1132          let scraps: Vec<Node> = current
1133            .get_child_nodes()
1134            .into_iter()
1135            .filter(|c| match c.get_type() {
1136              Some(NodeType::ElementNode) => c.get_name().ends_with("_Capture_"),
1137              Some(NodeType::PiNode) => c.get_name() == FIELD_MARK_TARGET,
1138              _ => false,
1139            })
1140            .collect();
1141          for scrap in scraps {
1142            if scrap.get_type() == Some(NodeType::PiNode) {
1143              self.remove_node(scrap);
1144            } else if scrap.get_first_element_child().is_some()
1145              || !scrap.get_content().trim().is_empty()
1146            {
1147              self.unwrap_nodes(scrap)?;
1148            } else {
1149              self.remove_node(scrap);
1150            }
1151          }
1152          let children = current.get_child_nodes();
1153          // Collect work items forward, then push in reverse for left-to-right processing
1154          let mut child_work: Vec<Work> = Vec::new();
1155          for child in &children {
1156            let child_type = child.get_type();
1157            if child_type == Some(NodeType::ElementNode) {
1158              let was_forcefont = child.has_attribute("_force_font");
1159              // Enter first, PostElement after (reversed when pushed to stack)
1160              child_work.push(Work::Enter(child.clone()));
1161              child_work.push(Work::PostElement {
1162                child: child.clone(),
1163                parent_qname: qname,
1164                was_forcefont,
1165              });
1166            } else if child_type == Some(NodeType::TextNode) {
1167              // Text node: wrap with font element if needed (handled inline)
1168              let mut text_keys_to_remove = Vec::new();
1169              for key in pending_declaration.keys() {
1170                if !can_have_attribute(FONT_ELEMENT_NAME, key) {
1171                  text_keys_to_remove.push(key.clone());
1172                }
1173              }
1174              for key in text_keys_to_remove {
1175                pending_declaration.remove(&key);
1176              }
1177              if can_contain(&current, FONT_ELEMENT_NAME)
1178                && !pending_declaration.is_empty()
1179                && let Some(mut text) = self.wrap_nodes(FONT_ELEMENT_NAME, vec![child.clone()])?
1180              {
1181                for (key, (value, _properties)) in pending_declaration.iter() {
1182                  self.set_attribute(&mut text, key, value)?;
1183                }
1184                // Text wrapper finalization is shallow (only text content), push to stack
1185                child_work.push(Work::Enter(text));
1186              }
1187            }
1188          }
1189          // Push in reverse so left-to-right processing order is maintained
1190          for work_item in child_work.into_iter().rev() {
1191            stack.push(work_item);
1192          }
1193        },
1194        Work::PostElement {
1195          child,
1196          parent_qname,
1197          was_forcefont,
1198        } => {
1199          // After finalizing a child element, check if it should be collapsed.
1200          // Use empty_attr_nodes set instead of child.get_attributes().is_empty()
1201          // to avoid traversing the attribute linked list, which can be corrupted
1202          // by prior replace_node operations in libxml2.
1203          // Defer the actual collapse to after the traversal completes, since
1204          // replace_node can corrupt ancestor attribute lists in libxml2.
1205          if (get_node_qname(&child) == pin!("ltx:text"))
1206            && !was_forcefont
1207            && empty_attr_nodes.contains(&child.to_hashable())
1208          {
1209            let grandchildren = child.get_child_nodes();
1210            if grandchildren
1211              .iter()
1212              .all(|gchild| can_contain_qsym(parent_qname, get_node_qname(gchild)))
1213            {
1214              deferred_collapses.push((child, parent_qname));
1215            }
1216          }
1217        },
1218        Work::PostWork { mut node } => {
1219          // Mirrors Perl `Document.pm:452`: at finalize time, ANY attribute
1220          // whose name starts with `_` is internal bookkeeping and gets
1221          // stripped. The set MUST be derived here, at PostWork time, and not
1222          // captured back at Enter, because descendant
1223          // `generate_id` calls can write `_ID_counter_<prefix>_` attributes
1224          // ONTO the current node (their nearest-id-bearing ancestor) during
1225          // child traversal — those late-added attrs were missing from the
1226          // Enter snapshot and would otherwise leak into the output XML,
1227          // causing duplicate xml:id collisions in the post-processing
1228          // libxml2 validator (1312.5864 cluster: 70× `S8.T5.m2241 already
1229          // defined`, where the Math element carried `_ID_counter__="1"`
1230          // populated post-Enter).
1231          //
1232          // EXCEPT the streaming pass-2 parse wrapper: it is never
1233          // serialized, and its `_ID_counter_*` attrs are how id numbering
1234          // carries ACROSS segments (read back after each segment — see
1235          // `streaming_pass2`).
1236          if get_node_qname(&node) != pin!("ltx:_lxfragment") {
1237            let attrs_now = node.get_attributes();
1238            let total_attrs = attrs_now.len();
1239            let bookkeeping_attrs: Vec<&String> = attrs_now
1240              .keys()
1241              .filter(|name| name.starts_with('_'))
1242              .collect();
1243            let bookkeeping_count = bookkeeping_attrs.len();
1244            for name in bookkeeping_attrs {
1245              let _ = node.remove_attribute(name);
1246            }
1247            // If all attributes were bookkeeping, the node now has empty attrs.
1248            if total_attrs <= bookkeeping_count {
1249              empty_attr_nodes.insert(node.to_hashable());
1250            }
1251          }
1252          if get_node_qname(&node) == pin!("ltx:Math") {
1253            math_outer_fonts.pop();
1254          }
1255          self.expire_local_font();
1256        },
1257      }
1258    }
1259    // Execute deferred font wrapper collapses now that the entire tree has been
1260    // finalized. Process from deepest (last) to shallowest (first) to avoid
1261    // corrupting ancestor attribute lists during the replacement operations.
1262    // This deferred approach prevents libxml2 memory corruption that occurs
1263    // when replace_node runs during tree traversal.
1264    for (child, _parent_qname) in deferred_collapses.into_iter().rev() {
1265      let grandchildren = child.get_child_nodes();
1266      if grandchildren.is_empty() {
1267        // Empty font wrapper — just remove it
1268        self.remove_node(child);
1269      } else {
1270        Debug!(
1271          "will replace {} grandchildren nodes in finalize_rec (deferred)",
1272          grandchildren.len()
1273        );
1274        self.replace_node(child, grandchildren)?;
1275      }
1276    }
1277    Ok(())
1278  }
1279
1280  /// Document construction at the Current Insertion Point.
1281  ///
1282  /// absorb the given $box into the DOM (called from constructors).
1283  /// This will return a list of whatever nodes were created.
1284  /// Note that this may include nodes that are children of other nodes in the list
1285  /// or nodes that are no longer in the document.
1286  /// Also, note that when a text nodes is appended to, the complete text node is in the list,
1287  /// not just the portion that was added.
1288  /// [Note that recording the nodes being constructed isn't all that costly,
1289  /// but filtering them for parent/child relations IS, particularly since it usually isn't needed]
1290  ///
1291  /// A box that is a TBox, or List, or Whatsit, is responsible for carrying out
1292  /// its own insertion, but it should ultimately call methods of Document
1293  /// that will record the nodes that were created.
1294  /// $box can also be a plain string (Digested::Postponed)
1295  /// which will be inserted according to whatever
1296  /// font, mode, etc, are in %props.
1297  pub fn absorb(&mut self, object: &Digested, props_opt: Option<SymHashMap<Stored>>) -> Result<()> {
1298    // a box's constructor absorbing material before it opened an element of its own: none is its own
1299    self.field_box_pending = false;
1300    if !self.field_marking_live() {
1301      return self.absorb_boxes(object, props_opt);
1302    }
1303    self.absorb_level += 1;
1304    let result = self.absorb_boxes(object, props_opt);
1305    // a run of field ink ends with the absorb that opened it (a table cell's, an environment body's)
1306    if result.is_ok()
1307      && self.field_inherit == 0
1308      && self
1309        .field_run
1310        .as_ref()
1311        .is_some_and(|r| r.level >= self.absorb_level)
1312    {
1313      self.close_field_run()?;
1314    }
1315    self.absorb_level -= 1;
1316    result
1317  }
1318
1319  /// Is field ink being marked (`FieldRun`)? Not once the frontmatter placement settled it, not in a conversion
1320  /// that stamped no field.
1321  #[inline]
1322  fn field_marking_live(&self) -> bool { FIELD_PROV_STAMPED.get() && !self.field_ink_settled }
1323
1324  /// Mark `element`, opened by a TeX box's constructor for its material (an `\hbox`'s `ltx:text`, a
1325  /// `\vbox`/`\parbox`/minipage capture, an alignment's container), with [`FIELD_BOX_ATTRIBUTE`]: the text a box
1326  /// sets is no body text of the page for a field's print outside it (latexml_engine `field_runs_after_body_text`,
1327  /// OXIDIZED_DESIGN #715). Only the element the box's own constructor opened, at the point it opens it: material a
1328  /// box absorbs straight into its context (a `\vbox` in a `\vbox`, a capture unwrapped) marks nothing (review r5
1329  /// finding 1).
1330  pub fn mark_field_box(&mut self, element: &mut Node) {
1331    if self.field_marking_live() && element.get_type() == Some(NodeType::ElementNode) {
1332      let _ = element.set_attribute(FIELD_BOX_ATTRIBUTE, "true");
1333    }
1334  }
1335
1336  /// Arm [`Self::mark_field_box`] for the next element opened ([`Self::open_element`]), when it is the caller's own
1337  /// (an alignment's `open_container`); [`Self::disarm_field_box`] after it.
1338  pub fn arm_field_box(&mut self) { self.field_box_pending = self.field_marking_live(); }
1339  /// Disarm [`Self::arm_field_box`].
1340  pub fn disarm_field_box(&mut self) { self.field_box_pending = false; }
1341
1342  /// Before absorbing `object`: open, continue or close the run of field ink (`FieldRun`) by the field provenance
1343  /// the box was digested with ([`FIELD_PROV_PROPERTY`]). Returns whether `object` is a field-ink whatsit whose own
1344  /// absorption is its ink (the caller counts it in `field_inherit` meanwhile). Nothing in math: a formula is one box of
1345  /// the text around it, and what it holds (an `\mbox` of the field) is no print of the field.
1346  fn field_ink_before(&mut self, object: &Digested) -> Result<bool> {
1347    if !self.field_marking_live() {
1348      return Ok(false);
1349    }
1350    // an alignment shown: the row-end markers its body consumed are taken now ([`FIELD_TAKEN_PROPERTY`]); a TeX box's
1351    // constructor ([`FIELD_BOX_PROPERTY`]): the first element it opens is marked
1352    if matches!(object.data(), DigestedData::Whatsit(_)) {
1353      self.field_box_pending = object.with_properties(|props| {
1354        if let Some(Stored::VecDequeStored(serials)) = props.get_sym(pin!("fieldTaken")) {
1355          for serial in serials {
1356            if let Stored::Int(serial) = serial
1357              && let Ok(serial) = u32::try_from(*serial)
1358            {
1359              crate::token::field_ledger_take(serial);
1360            }
1361          }
1362        }
1363        props.get_sym(pin!("fieldBox")).is_some()
1364      });
1365    }
1366    // `fieldProv` ([`FIELD_PROV_PROPERTY`]), by its cached symbol and without a copy: this runs for every box
1367    let (prov, serial) = object.with_properties(|props| match props.get_sym(pin!("fieldProv")) {
1368      Some(Stored::Int(p)) => (*p as u16, match props.get_sym(pin!("fieldSerial")) {
1369        Some(Stored::Int(s)) => u32::try_from(*s).ok(),
1370        _ => None,
1371      }),
1372      _ => (0, None),
1373    });
1374    let field = crate::token::field_prov_field(prov);
1375    if self.field_inherit > 0 {
1376      // inside a field-ink whatsit: its ink, whatever provenance its parts have (a formula's characters count for the
1377      // run's extent: `Szabo$^3$` ends with the `3`)
1378      if prov != 0
1379        && let Some(run) = self.field_run.as_mut()
1380        && run.field == field
1381        && let Some(serial) = serial
1382      {
1383        run.take(serial);
1384      }
1385      return Ok(false);
1386    }
1387    // (the common case first: a box of no field, no run open — nothing to do)
1388    if prov == 0 {
1389      if self.field_run.is_some() && !self.in_math_node() {
1390        self.close_field_run()?;
1391      }
1392      return Ok(false);
1393    }
1394    if self.in_math_node() {
1395      return Ok(false);
1396    }
1397    let Some(serial) = serial else {
1398      // a box the full ledger holds no cover of: no whole print
1399      if self.field_run.is_some() {
1400        self.close_field_run()?;
1401      }
1402      return Ok(false);
1403    };
1404    let cover = crate::token::field_ledger_entry(serial).map_or_else(Default::default, |e| e.cover);
1405    match self.field_run.as_mut() {
1406      // the value read on in its order (the boxes of one macro's expansion all start at the macro's position; a
1407      // construct's own box, absorbed around what its argument made, covers it: `\textsc{One}`'s whatsit after `One`)
1408      Some(run) if run.field == field && cover.end > run.max_start => {
1409        run.take(serial);
1410        run.max_start = run.max_start.max(cover.start);
1411      },
1412      // another field's ink, or the value read again from before a position the run reached (`\StrLeft{\@title}{3}
1413      // \@title`: the second print's `T`): a print of its own
1414      _ => {
1415        if self.field_run.is_some() {
1416          self.close_field_run()?;
1417        }
1418        self.open_field_run(field, serial, cover.start)?;
1419      },
1420    }
1421    Ok(!matches!(object.data(), DigestedData::TBox(_)))
1422  }
1423
1424  /// Is the insertion point in math (inside an `ltx:Math`: a formula's tokens, an `\mbox` in it)?
1425  fn in_math_node(&self) -> bool {
1426    let mut node = if self.node.get_type() == Some(NodeType::ElementNode) {
1427      Some(self.node.clone())
1428    } else {
1429      self.node.get_parent()
1430    };
1431    while let Some(element) = node {
1432      if element.get_type() != Some(NodeType::ElementNode) {
1433        return false;
1434      }
1435      if arena::with(get_node_qname(&element), |q| {
1436        q.starts_with("ltx:XM") || q == "ltx:Math"
1437      }) {
1438        return true;
1439      }
1440      node = element.get_parent();
1441    }
1442    false
1443  }
1444
1445  /// Append a field mark (a [`FIELD_MARK_TARGET`] processing instruction) at the insertion point, the open text node
1446  /// closed first, so the ink on each side of it is in its own node. Returns false where no element takes it.
1447  fn append_field_mark(&mut self, content: &str) -> Result<bool> {
1448    let mut element = self.close_text_internal()?;
1449    if element.get_type() != Some(NodeType::ElementNode) {
1450      return Ok(false);
1451    }
1452    let Ok(mut mark) = self
1453      .document
1454      .create_processing_instruction(FIELD_MARK_TARGET, content)
1455    else {
1456      return Ok(false);
1457    };
1458    element.add_child(&mut mark)?;
1459    Ok(true)
1460  }
1461
1462  fn open_field_run(&mut self, field: u16, serial: u32, start: u16) -> Result<()> {
1463    let id = self.field_run_serial + 1;
1464    if self.append_field_mark(&s!("begin {field} {id}"))? {
1465      self.field_run_serial = id;
1466      self.field_run = Some(FieldRun {
1467        field,
1468        id,
1469        level: self.absorb_level,
1470        serials: vec![(serial, serial)],
1471        max_start: start,
1472      });
1473    }
1474    Ok(())
1475  }
1476
1477  fn close_field_run(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
1478    if let Some(run) = self.field_run.take() {
1479      let serials = run
1480        .serials
1481        .iter()
1482        .map(|(first, last)| s!("{first}:{last}"))
1483        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
1484        .join(",");
1485      self.append_field_mark(&s!("end {} {} {serials}", run.field, run.id))?;
1486    }
1487    Ok(())
1488  }
1489
1490  /// Close the open run of field ink, if any, and mark no more (`FieldRun`): the frontmatter placement settled it.
1491  /// The field ledger records no more either ([`field_ledger_settle`](crate::token::field_ledger_settle)).
1492  pub fn settle_field_ink(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
1493    if self.field_run.is_some() {
1494      self.close_field_run()?;
1495    }
1496    self.field_ink_settled = true;
1497    crate::token::field_ledger_settle();
1498    Ok(())
1499  }
1500
1501  fn absorb_boxes(
1502    &mut self,
1503    object: &Digested,
1504    props_opt: Option<SymHashMap<Stored>>,
1505  ) -> Result<()> {
1506    use DigestedData::*;
1507    let props = props_opt.unwrap_or_default();
1508    let mut boxes = vec![Cow::Borrowed(object)];
1509    while let Some(front_box) = boxes.pop() {
1510      // Cooperative guard tick — the SAME one the digestion loops run
1511      // (`stomach.rs`, three sites). Build had none, and Build is where a large
1512      // document actually peaks: measured 2026-07-29 on 800k words of plain
1513      // prose, digest ends under 2 GB while Build takes it to 6.4 GB (54 % of
1514      // wall, ~70 % of peak RSS). So `--max-memory` guarded only the cheap
1515      // phase, and what a user hit was the HARD watchdog: SIGKILL, exit 137, no
1516      // `Fatal:` line, no partial document — the 0-byte output reported against
1517      // rc4 on a 131 MB source. The tick makes the ceiling cooperative here
1518      // too, so an over-budget document degrades to a graceful Fatal that the
1519      // caller can salvage from (`core_interface::convert_document`).
1520      //
1521      // Cost is negligible: `check_timeout` only samples RSS every ~1024 calls,
1522      // and this loop already does far more work per iteration than a counter
1523      // increment.
1524      crate::stomach::check_timeout()?;
1525      match front_box.data() {
1526        List(list) => {
1527          // Simply unwind Lists to avoid unneccessary recursion; This occurs quite frequently!
1528          for tbox in list.borrow().unlist().into_iter().rev() {
1529            boxes.push(Cow::Owned(tbox));
1530          }
1531        },
1532        // A Proper Box or Whatsit? Absorb it.
1533        TBox(digested) => {
1534          raise_absorb_warning(&front_box);
1535          self.field_ink_before(&front_box)?;
1536          self.set_box_to_absorb(Some((*front_box).clone()));
1537          self.init_constructed_nodes();
1538          digested.borrow().be_absorbed(self)?;
1539          // record these for OUTER caller, but return only the most recent set
1540          self.close_constructed_nodes();
1541          self.expire_box_to_absorb();
1542        },
1543        Whatsit(digested) => {
1544          raise_absorb_warning(&front_box);
1545          let field_ink = self.field_ink_before(&front_box)?;
1546          self.field_inherit += u32::from(field_ink);
1547          self.set_box_to_absorb(Some((*front_box).clone()));
1548          self.init_constructed_nodes();
1549          let absorbed = digested.borrow().be_absorbed(self);
1550          self.field_box_pending = false;
1551          self.field_inherit -= u32::from(field_ink);
1552          absorbed?;
1553          self.close_constructed_nodes();
1554          self.expire_box_to_absorb();
1555        },
1556        Alignment(alignment) => {
1557          self.set_box_to_absorb(Some((*front_box).clone()));
1558          self.init_constructed_nodes();
1559          // A self-referential alignment (transitively contains itself) would
1560          // re-enter `borrow_mut` here and panic ("already borrowed"). Guard like
1561          // the size-computation traversal (digested.rs) and skip the re-entrant
1562          // absorption to break the cycle. Witness: astro-ph0310145 et al.
1563          match alignment.try_borrow_mut() {
1564            Ok(mut a) => {
1565              a.be_absorbed_mut(self)?;
1566            },
1567            Err(_) => {
1568              // Degrading MUST be loud (fail-toward-flagging): the whole
1569              // alignment's content is being dropped from the output.
1570              Error!(
1571                "unexpected",
1572                "self_referential_alignment",
1573                "Skipping absorption of a self-referential alignment (its content is lost)"
1574              );
1575            },
1576          }
1577          self.close_constructed_nodes();
1578          self.expire_box_to_absorb();
1579        },
1580        Comment(comment) => {
1581          comment.be_absorbed(self)?;
1582        },
1583        Postponed(tokens) => {
1584          let text_font_opt = if let Some(Stored::Font(prop_font)) = props.get("font") {
1585            Some(Rc::clone(prop_font))
1586          } else {
1587            match self.box_to_absorb {
1588              Some(ref thisbox) => thisbox.get_font()?,
1589              None => None,
1590            }
1591          };
1592          let text_font = text_font_opt.unwrap_or_default();
1593          if let Some(new_text) = self.open_text(&tokens.to_string(), &text_font)? {
1594            self.record_constructed_node(&new_text);
1595          }
1596        },
1597        KeyVals(kv) => {
1598          // When KeyVals appear in body absorption (e.g. #1 for RequiredKeyVals),
1599          // convert them to text representation matching Perl's stringify behavior.
1600          let text = kv.to_string();
1601          if !text.is_empty() {
1602            let text_font = match self.box_to_absorb {
1603              Some(ref thisbox) => thisbox.get_font()?.unwrap_or_default(),
1604              None => Rc::default(),
1605            };
1606            if let Some(new_text) = self.open_text(&text, &text_font)? {
1607              self.record_constructed_node(&new_text);
1608            }
1609          }
1610        },
1611        RegisterValue(_) => {
1612          // RegisterValue should not normally appear in the absorption pipeline.
1613        },
1614      }
1615    }
1616    Ok(())
1617  }
1618
1619  fn init_constructed_nodes(&mut self) {
1620    // Pop a buffer from the free-list (retaining its previously-grown capacity);
1621    // fall back to a fresh empty Vec if the pool is dry. Swap it in as the new
1622    // inner frame; the outgoing outer frame goes onto the save stack.
1623    let fresh = self.reusable_node_buffers.pop().unwrap_or_default();
1624    let prev = std::mem::replace(&mut self.constructed_nodes, fresh);
1625    self.localized_constructed_nodes.push(prev);
1626  }
1627
1628  /// Close the current constructed-nodes frame, restoring the outer frame and
1629  /// re-recording the inner frame's nodes into it. The drained inner buffer
1630  /// is returned to `reusable_node_buffers` (empty but with capacity intact)
1631  /// so the next `init_constructed_nodes` can reuse it without allocating.
1632  fn close_constructed_nodes(&mut self) {
1633    let outer = self.localized_constructed_nodes.pop().unwrap_or_default();
1634    let mut inner = std::mem::replace(&mut self.constructed_nodes, outer);
1635    for n in inner.drain(..) {
1636      self.record_constructed_node(&n);
1637    }
1638    // `inner` is now empty; its capacity is preserved. Return it to the pool.
1639    self.reusable_node_buffers.push(inner);
1640  }
1641  pub fn get_constructed_nodes(&self) -> &[Node] { &self.constructed_nodes }
1642
1643  /// This is a refactored `else` cases from the main absorb routine, to allow for better type
1644  /// hygiene
1645  pub fn absorb_string(
1646    &mut self,
1647    object: &str,
1648    props: &SymHashMap<Stored>,
1649  ) -> Result<Option<Node>> {
1650    // a box's constructor setting text before it opened an element of its own: none is its own
1651    self.field_box_pending = false;
1652    // Else, plain string in text mode.
1653    let ismath: bool = match props.get("isMath") {
1654      Some(v) => v.into(),
1655      None => false,
1656    };
1657    if !ismath {
1658      // Perf: avoid cloning Rc<Font> into owned Font in the common case.
1659      // We pull out the Rc (shared reference is fine since open_text only
1660      // borrows the Font, not self) and go through Cow<Font>.
1661      let font_opt: Option<Rc<Font>> = match props.get("font") {
1662        Some(Stored::Font(fnt)) => Some(Rc::clone(fnt)),
1663        Some(Stored::FontDirective(FontDirective::Asset(fnt))) => Some(Rc::clone(fnt)),
1664        _ => None,
1665      };
1666      if let Some(fnt) = font_opt {
1667        return self.open_text(object, &fnt);
1668      }
1669      if let Some(Stored::FontDirective(FontDirective::Closure(code))) = props.get("font") {
1670        let fnt = code(None)?;
1671        return self.open_text(object, &fnt);
1672      }
1673      // Fallback to box_to_absorb font.
1674      let fnt = self.box_to_absorb.as_ref().unwrap().get_font()?.unwrap();
1675      self.open_text(object, &fnt)
1676    } else if get_node_qname(&self.node) == pin!("ltx:XMTok") {
1677      // Or plain string in math mode.
1678      // Note text nodes can ONLY appear in <XMTok> or <text>!!!
